_comment: Hand-injected for #1248. Filename-specific fixtures MUST stay above the generic fallback: aimock is first-match-wins and the generic userMessage is an unanchored substring of every filename-tagged request. Client classify appends `Uploaded filename: <name>` so photo vs sheet vs creature can diverge; server-side create still sends the untagged prompt and hits the fallback.
